## About
Mathews-Carlsen Body Works is a full service auto body shop on Faber Place in Palo Alto, centrally located to all the peninsula cities. We work on all makes and models with an emphasis on European cars, and every vehicle gets the same professional treatment.
The shop was started by Carl Carlsen and later took its current name when Marshall Mathews came on as partner. Today J. R. Montelongo, who was once the shop's head painter, and Nancy Mathews own the shop and keep to the values Carl and Marshall brought to it. The city of Palo Alto has recognized us as a Clean Bay Business.
Getting into an accident is stressful. Our aim is to make getting your car repaired and back to you as easy as we can. Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 98 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair: Anything from small dents and scrapes to major collision damage, including frame repair and replacement. Our goal is to restore your car to the way it was before the accident.
- Paint and color matching: Quality body repair and color matched paint using Glasurit products.
- European models: We specialize in European models like Porsche, BMW and Mercedes.
- Insurance claim help: We have a direct repair relationship with several insurance companies and work well with all the others. Call us and ask what your next step is.

## FAQ
Q: Do I get to choose my repair shop?
A: Yes. Under California law you have the right to choose which repair facility works on your car. The choice is yours.

Q: When can I come in for an estimate?
A: Please call ahead to check estimate availability before you come by.

Q: Can I request an estimate online?
A: Yes. You can request an estimate from our shop on carwise.com.

Q: How do I check on my repair?
A: You can check your repair status on carwise.com, or give us a call during office hours.
